title: Lab flesh
text: Is lab flesh vegan? No. Lab flesh reinforces the idea that animals exist for us to use. It does not challenge anyone to end using them. Its goal is to reduce suffering in one form of use, which is a welfare position, not a vegan one. Veganism rejects animal use regardless of whether the use is painful. Notice what lab flesh does not touch. Not zoos. Not horse racing. Not vivisection. Not riding. Not wool. It is not a stance against use. It is a stance against suffering inside one industry. The category flesh stays on the table. The animal stays a resource. The mindset stays exactly as it was. The only thing that changes is the equipment. As Leslie Cross wrote in 1951, veganism is a principle, that man has no right to exploit the creatures for his own ends, and no variation occurs.
